meta_description:
46K likes, 347 comments - malvikasitlaniofficial on October 1, 2026: "Them: How did you do it? 

Me: Il tell you. Strength train 4 times a week, no matter what life throws at you. 

Them: I’m too lazy Mals, I want to lose weight but I’m not motivated. 

Me: But that’s what I did 🤷🏻‍♀️😳 I gave it all I had. 

Them: But Mals you made it look so easy, cmon. 

Me: Easy? I built this in 3 years and in those 3 years, I got pregnant, birthed her, had postpartum depression, got divorced, became a single mom, got even more depressed, moved countries, lost both my parents in a gap of 3 months…🙂
Easy you say? 😊 Nah, I just gave it everything I had 🫶🏻

If you haven’t gone through half of this ^ and you’re still binge eating on your couch… and NOT in the gym, then we got work to do my friend. 

You have no excuse. 

Get. To. It. 👏🏼".
